subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this grouped set of 13 new third-party action commits in its credential-bearing, security-scanning, release, automation, and Codex workflows after the branch is refreshed and the failing gate is resolved?
rationale: Source inspection finds no mechanical defect, but accepting new executable action code at these privilege boundaries is a repository trust decision that automated review cannot safely make.

options.title: Approve refreshed batch
options.body: Refresh the branch, require the affected exact-head checks to pass or be proven unrelated, then approve the reviewed SHA-pinned action releases as one batch.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate token, Codex, security-scanning, and release-action upgrades into smaller PRs if owners want independent rollout and rollback boundaries.

options.title: Hold current pins
options.body: Close or pause this batch and retain the existing action commits until owners are ready to review each upstream change.

recommendation.title: Approve refreshed batch
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, require the affected exact-head checks to pass or be proven unrelated, then approve the reviewed SHA-pinned action releases as one batch.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies this account as project lead, and workflow history shows the strongest sustained ownership of the central CI and release surfaces.
